title: CI Failure Fix: xserver build with GBM disabled
subtitle: Resolved byte-swapping issues in randr/render tests
body:
## Summary

Fixed CI failure in xserver-build-ubuntu-no-gbm job caused by commit a1acf90c52.

## Root Cause

Commit a1acf90c52 changed GBM dependency handling:
- Replaced  with  when not building GBM
- Changed  check from  to 

This caused GBM feature flags to be undefined when GBM was disabled (-Dgbm=false), breaking glamor's fallback path and resulting in byte-swapping errors in randr, render, and present tests.

## Solution

Reverted commit a1acf90c52 to restore:
- GBM dependency uses  when not building GBM
- GBM feature flags set based on  (header/symbol presence) when glamor is enabled

This restores proper defines in dix-config.h (e.g., ) allowing glamor's GBM code path to work correctly.

## Verification

- Built xserver with 
- Full test suite passes: 46 OK, 2 skipped (XTs/go-xts), 0 failed
- Previously failing tests now pass:
  - test_randr.py::TestRandRSetScreenConfig::test_set_screen_config_config_timestamp_swapped
  - test_randr.py::TestRandRCreateLease::test_create_lease_lid_swapped
  - test_render.py tests

## Communication

Reported resolution to Enterprise via agent-bus directive m0002.

## Next Steps

A follow-up task is needed to fix the underlying byte-swapping issue in glamor's non-GBM path to allow the original improvements from commit a1acf90c52 to be reapplied safely.
